xrefdescription.para: TQC-01a: 10 sequential requests of 100 tokens each against a 500-token quota. First 5 must be admitted; requests 6-10 must be denied.

detaileddescription.para: Sequential baseline — establishes correctness before adding concurrency.

xrefdescription.para:
TQC-01b: N concurrent threads each attempt to consume tokens that together exceed the quota. After all threads complete:
Total tokens consumed must NOT exceed the quota.
At least one request must have been denied.
No negative balance.
TQC-02a: Two threads each attempt to consume exactly the remaining quota simultaneously. Only ONE must succeed; the other must be denied; the balance must never go negative.
TQC-02b: Multiple threads targeting quota = 0 (fully exhausted).

para.verbatim: Pre-consume the full quota, then launch concurrent requests. All subsequent requests must be denied; balance must remain at exactly the quota limit (no overshoot).

xrefdescription.para: TQC-02c: Check returns denied even for a 0-token request when quota is fully consumed (edge case: zero-sized request).

briefdescription.para: Block 4 — Token-Quota Enforcement Under Concurrent Requests (High).

detaileddescription.para: Acceptance criteria: TQC-01 N concurrent requests that together exceed the configured quota → all requests submitted AFTER quota exhaustion are denied (no request that pushes the balance negative is ever accepted). TQC-02 Race-condition at boundary: exact quota value reached by multiple threads simultaneously → no negative balance recorded.
All infrastructure is fully in-process. The TokenQuotaManager's thread-safe sliding-window implementation is exercised directly without mocking.
